copy.meaning_procedural_error: The difficulty seems to be in choosing a solving method: the child knows part of the material, but does not always pick the right step for the question.
copy.meaning_procedure_break: There seems to be confusion about the order of steps, so it helps to walk through the method together, step by step.
copy.meaning_calculation_error: The difficulty tends to repeat at the calculation step or order of operations, so it helps to break the problem into smaller steps.
copy.meaning_conceptual_error: There seems to be a foundational mix-up with the material, not just a one-time calculation slip.
copy.meaning_conceptual_misunderstanding: There seems to be a foundational mix-up with the material, not just a one-time calculation slip.
copy.meaning_strategy_gap: The difficulty seems to be in choosing a solving method, not necessarily a lack of knowledge.
copy.meaning_prerequisite_gap: A small foundational skill may be worth reinforcing before moving on to harder topics.
copy.meaning_reading_comprehension_issue: The difficulty may be related to understanding the question or text, not just calculation or recall.
copy.meaning_vocabulary_gap: Missing words or terms may be making it harder for the child to understand what is being asked.
copy.meaning_speed_pressure: Some mistakes appear related to speed - it helps to work through the question at a calmer pace.
copy.meaning_careless_or_attention: The material appears partly familiar, but small slips repeat when working quickly.
copy.meaning_guessing_or_unstable: Answers look less consistent, so it helps to check the solving method together, not just the result.
